issue.title: GUT-3: Paint the tile strip chili red
issue.body:
**Ticket:** [GUT-3](https://abobskie.atlassian.net/browse/GUT-3)

## Summary

This changes the colour of the tile strip at the top of the bar from jade to chili red. It is one of two colours for GUT-3. The other colour, kaya yellow, is on the Branch `feat/GUT-3-kaya-tile-strip`.

```diff
 /* src/app/globals.css */
 .tile-strip {
-  background: repeating-conic-gradient(var(--color-jade) 0 25%, ...
+  background: repeating-conic-gradient(var(--color-chili) 0 25%, ...
 }
```

## Evidence

- No check ran on a local computer. The CI of this pull request runs lint, typecheck, the tests and the build.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

To go back, put `--color-jade` back.

**Blast Radius:** appearance

Each page shows the tile strip in a different colour.
